shadow_wolf.name: Shadow Wolf
shadow_wolf.special: Leaps past the front line to attack the weakest hero.

skeleton_warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton_warrior.special: Revives once with 30% HP unless burned.

poison_spider.name: Poison Spider
poison_spider.special: Applies poison + can trap a hero in a web.

stone_knoll.name: Stone Knoll
stone_knoll.special: High Defense. Splits when critically hit.

cherry_spirit.name: Corrupt Cherry Spirit
cherry_spirit.special: Can charm a hero for 1 turn.

mushroom_farmer.name: Mushroom Farmer
mushroom_farmer.special: Spawns small mushroom minions every turn.

iron_golem.name: Iron Golem
iron_golem.special: Extremely high Defense. Magic deals more damage.

shadow_assassin.name: Shadow Assassin
shadow_assassin.special: High crit chance + can vanish for 1 turn.

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.special: Terrifying wail that can make heroes skip their turn.

crystal_spider.name: Crystal Spider
crystal_spider.special: Her web lowers both Speed and Defense.

drakkin_warrior.name: Drakkin Warrior
drakkin_warrior.special: Enters a raging form that greatly boosts ATK.

black_knight.name: Black Knight
black_knight.special: High Defense + reflects part of the damage.

storm_elemental.name: Storm Elemental
storm_elemental.special: Chain lightning + partial immunity to physical attacks.

blood_master.name: Blood Master
blood_master.special: Sacrifices own HP to massively buff an ally.

elder_giant.name: Elder Stone Giant
elder_giant.special: Earthquake (AoE + stun chance) + huge HP pool.

black_drakeling.name: Black Drakeling
black_drakeling.special: Fire breath + a weaker Dragon Form.

shadow_demon.name: Shadow Demon
shadow_demon.special: Grows stronger the more debuffs your team has.

ice_queen.name: Ice Queen
ice_queen.special: Can freeze the whole team + creates ice barriers.

war_golem.name: War Golem
war_golem.special: Switches between offensive and defensive form.

soul_eater.name: Soul Eater
soul_eater.special: Steals life force and grows stronger from it.

time_twister.name: Time Twister
time_twister.special: Can make a hero skip a turn or act twice itself.

fallen_star.name: The Fallen Star
fallen_star.special: Combines holy and shadow magic. Heals itself and casts devastating AoE.

frost_warg.name: Frost Warg
frost_warg.special: A slowing frost bite – its howl empowers the whole pack.

bog_crawler.name: Bog Crawler
bog_crawler.special: A venomous sting and marsh gas that poisons the whole team.

ash_imp.name: Ash Imp
ash_imp.special: Sparks that ignite and ash clouds that lower ATK. Immune to fire.

grave_hound.name: Grave Hound
grave_hound.special: Hunts the weakest hero and rises once after death.

rune_wisp.name: Rune Wisp
rune_wisp.special: Hard to hit and heals its wounded allies.

peat_brute.name: Peat Brute
peat_brute.special: A tough peat body that regenerates and slows with its blows.

snow_harpy.name: Snow Harpy
snow_harpy.special: Fast – dives at several targets and lowers their SPD.

rust_tick.name: Rust Tick
rust_tick.special: Corrodes armor (lowers DEF) and drains life.

choir_shade.name: Choir Shade
choir_shade.special: A dirge that can stun the whole team.

ember_boar.name: Ember Boar
ember_boar.special: A blazing charge that burns and can stun.

glass_archer.name: Glass Archer
glass_archer.special: Prism volleys at random targets with high crit chance.

plague_monk.name: Plague Monk
plague_monk.special: Plague mist that poisons and weakens the whole team.

dune_serpent.name: Dune Serpent
dune_serpent.special: A venomous bite and a sandstorm that slows everyone.

hex_doll.name: Hex Doll
hex_doll.special: Curses the team (ATK/SPD down) and stitches itself back together once.

coral_knight.name: Coral Knight
coral_knight.special: Taunts behind a coral shield and reflects damage.

thunder_ram.name: Thunder Ram
thunder_ram.special: A thunder charge with a high chance to stun.

bone_chanter.name: Bone Chanter
bone_chanter.special: Raises skeletons and boosts its allies' ATK.

cinder_monk.name: Cinder Monk
cinder_monk.special: Double strikes, a burning fist and a healing meditation.

mist_stalker.name: Mist Stalker
mist_stalker.special: Hard to hit – pounces on the weakest hero.

clockwork_squire.name: Clockwork Squire
clockwork_squire.special: Ironskin against physical damage; winds itself up for more ATK and SPD.

mire_hag.name: Mire Hag
mire_hag.special: Curses, a healing brew and a flood that grows with every debuff.

forge_tyrant.name: Forge Tyrant
forge_tyrant.special: A furnace blast on everyone and an anvil crush that can stun. Immune to fire.

pale_stag.name: Pale Stag
pale_stag.special: Heals and cleanses its allies, tramples the whole team.

drowned_admiral.name: Drowned Admiral
drowned_admiral.special: Summons his dead crew, rallies his allies and fires broadsides.

magma_behemoth.name: Magma Behemoth
magma_behemoth.special: Huge HP, lava vents that burn and an eruption that can stun.

frost_colossus.name: Frost Colossus
frost_colossus.special: A glacier shield and an avalanche that can freeze the whole team.

silk_matron.name: Silk Matron
silk_matron.special: Snares the team in silk and breeds spiders.

oathbreaker.name: Oathbreaker
oathbreaker.special: Breaks the team (ATK/DEF down) and judges with a guaranteed crit on the debuffed.

eclipse_wyrm.name: Eclipse Wyrm
eclipse_wyrm.special: Alternates sun and shadow – burns, DEF down and a total eclipse.

nameless_bell.name: The Nameless Bell
nameless_bell.special: Silent peals that stun and erase the weakest hero.

plague_moth_queen.name: The Plague Moth Queen
plague_moth_queen.special: Spore storms that poison everyone, hypnotic wings that charm and a plague bloom that grows with every debuff.

slag_king.name: The Slag King
slag_king.special: Molten armor that reflects damage, a crucible that burns the whole team. Immune to fire.

storm_jarl.name: The Storm Jarl
storm_jarl.special: Chain lightning that stuns, a frost crown that makes him immune to CC and a ragnarok bolt.

kraken_matriarch.name: The Kraken Matriarch
kraken_matriarch.special: Ink clouds that lower ATK, a crushing grip that stuns and a maelstrom that slows everyone.

hollow_saint.name: The Hollow Saint
hollow_saint.special: Heals and becomes immune to debuffs, erases armor and blinds with a false dawn.
